variants.headline: Accident at a workplace
variants.sub: The colony has had an accident at a workplace.
variants.body:
An accident has occurred at a workplace in {colony}. The occurrence is established, while a particular injury or legal finding is not supplied here. Readers considering {target} should distinguish scrutiny of safety responsibility from an invented account of the accident's cause or the condition of those involved.

A workplace accident warrants management attention without an invented estimate of liability or lost output. The event, its cause and any legal finding are distinct subjects. A disciplined assessment should take safety seriously while avoiding a financial calculation or an attribution of fault unsupported by the particulars supplied here.

The role of {target} merits scrutiny against the accident. This paper does not presume a breach of rules or announce consequences for workers that have not been established in the reported particulars. Reliable assessment begins with particulars rather than a politically convenient assumption.
